title: Prosecuting officers, duty.
bodyText: On notice from any member of the board of dentistry, the several prosecuting officers of the State shall institute prosecutions for offenses under this chapter.
bodyHtml: §448-22  Prosecuting officers, duty.  On notice from any member of the board of dentistry, the several prosecuting officers of the State shall institute prosecutions for offenses under this chapter. [L 1903, c 40, §16; RL 1925, §1082; RL 1935, §997; RL 1945, §2169; RL 1955, §61-22; HRS §448-22; am L 2018, c 203, §4]
